disclaimer: General veterinary guidance based on WSAVA & Indian veterinary standards. Always confirm with a licensed veterinarian.

vaccines.name: DHPPiL / 7-in-1 / 9-in-1 Core Combination
vaccines.notes: Essential core vaccine protecting against fatal viral and bacterial diseases prevalent in India.

doses.label: Puppy DP / DHPPiL Dose 1
doses.description: Initial priming dose once maternal antibodies start waning.

doses.label: DHPPiL Dose 2
doses.description: Second booster dose to ensure immune response.

doses.label: DHPPiL Dose 3
doses.description: Final puppy series dose providing long-term immunity.

vaccines.name: Anti-Rabies Vaccine (ARV)
vaccines.notes: Legally mandated and vital in India. Administered at 12-16 weeks followed by a booster dose 3-4 weeks later, then annually.

doses.label: Rabies First-Year Booster
doses.description: Booster administered 3-4 weeks after primary dose to consolidate immunity.

vaccines.name: Kennel Cough (Bordetella / Canine Parainfluenza)
vaccines.notes: Highly recommended for dogs visiting dog parks (Cubbon Park), boarding kennels, or grooming salons in urban areas.

doses.label: Kennel Cough Dose 1
doses.description: Intranasal or subcutaneous immunization for social dogs.

vaccines.name: Canine Coronavirus (CCoV)
vaccines.notes: Optional gastrointestinal protection, frequently given with puppy combinations in multi-dog environments.

dewormingSchedule.notes: Puppies need deworming every 2 weeks up to 12 weeks, monthly up to 6 months, and every 3 months for adults.

tickFleaSchedule.notes: Continuous prevention is essential year-round in Bengaluru, with peak flea/tick pressure during monsoon (June-September) and post-monsoon humidity.
